units.source_text: 我下棋时，道子同朝仓站在大雄宝殿后面的窗户旁边。

en.t: While I was playing go, Michiko and Asakura stood by the window behind the main hall.

units.source_text: 今年秋天阴雨连绵，今天少有的灿烂的阳光，洒落在庭园的茶花树叶上，反映在他们的身上，清晰地描画出他们两人的姿影。

en.t: This autumn had been full of endless rain, but today a rare, brilliant sunlight fell on the camellia leaves in the garden, reflected onto them, and clearly outlined the figures of the two of them.
